meta.greeting: Welcome home. The light's lovely today.
meta.rationale: Just the light of a warm afternoon indoors: apricot sun coming in low, a rosy haze, lavender in the shade, dust glinting in the beams. Nothing in the room but the feeling of being home.
meta.theme-about: warm late-afternoon light, cosy and soft, with no objects at all: a full-screen canvas of pure light, a peach-to-rose wash with a big soft sun bloom low on the left, a few slanting beams of light, slow dust motes glinting in them, and lavender haze in the shaded corner; cream frosted surfaces, apricot and honey accents, warm plum-brown text, rounded and gentle. Coming home. (#light, #hello, #dock)

desktop.canvas: function draw(w, h, t) -- the room's light: peach where the sun is, rose in the middle, lavender in the shade g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#fde8d6", "#e9bfb6") g.glow(w * 0.92, h * 1.0, h * 0.9, "#b9a6c855") g.glow(w * 0.75, h * 0.15, h * 0.6, "#f4c6c044") -- the low sun, just off the left edge, breathing very slowly local b = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.25) g.glow(-w * 0.02, h * 0.3, h * (0.85 + 0.04 * b), "#fff1d888") g.glow(w * 0.02, h * 0.28, h * 0.4, "#fff8ec99") -- slanting beams, as if through two tall windows local function beam(x0, wd, a) g.poly({x0, -20, x0 + wd, -20, x0 + wd + w * 0.55, h + 20, x0 + w * 0.55 - wd * 0.4, h + 20}, string.format("#fff6e6%02x", a)) end local s = math.floor(4 * math.sin(t * 0.3)) beam(w * 0.04, w * 0.07, 30 + s) beam(w * 0.14, w * 0.05, 24 - s) beam(w * 0.24, w * 0.08, 20 + s) -- dust drifting in the light, glinting now and then for i = 0, 46 do local px = (i * 197 + t * (3 + i % 5)) % (w * 0.75) local py = (i * 131 + t * (5 + i % 3) + math.sin(t * 0.4 + i) * 18) % h local tw = (math.sin(t * (0.6 + (i % 6) * 0.15) + i * 1.7) + 1) / 2 g.circle(px, py, (i % 4 == 0) and 1.8 or 1.1, string.format("#fffaf0%02x", math.floor(40 + 150 * tw))) if i % 9 == 0 then g.glow(px, py, 9, string.format("#fff4dc%02x", math.floor(70 * tw))) end end end
